title: Conduit Fittings Price in Pakistan 2026 — PVC & GI Conduit Accessories, Junction Boxes & Conduit Bodies Complete Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete buyer guide to electrical conduit fittings in Pakistan 2026. Covers PVC and GI couplings, locknuts, bushings, conduit bodies (LB/LL/LR/T/C), IP65 junction boxes, liquid-tight flexible conduit fittings, saddles, and expansion couplings.
